Career Journey  
I started in cybersecurity with a focus on healthcare data protection, driven by the industry’s unique regulatory demands. Over six years, I’ve evolved from a systems analyst to a senior security architect, leading initiatives that balance innovation with compliance. My work at HealthGuard Technologies has centered on securing patient data while enabling seamless digital health solutions.  

Current Focus  
Today, I’m deeply involved in strengthening our cloud infrastructure’s resilience against evolving threats. This includes refining SOC2 and GDPR compliance frameworks, integrating advanced SIEM tools, and designing zero-trust architectures. My goal is to ensure every layer of our systems—from APIs to databases—meets the highest security standards without compromising user experience.  

Skills Highlight  
I’ve owned critical projects like a SOC2 audit that cut remediation time by 30% and a penetration test that uncovered vulnerabilities in our HIPAA-compliant platforms. My expertise in threat modeling has shaped secure API designs, while my IAM frameworks reduced unauthorized access by 40% across 50+ systems. I also mentor junior engineers on OWASP principles and lead incident response drills that improve team readiness by 25%.  

Call to Action  
If you’re tackling complex security challenges in healthtech or need guidance on compliance, threat modeling, or incident response, let’s connect. Let’s build systems that protect what matters most.
